purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 20-record item effect batch 018; together these files contain exactly 20 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/cubic-gate-295.name: Cubic Gate
items/cubic-gate-295.effectSummary: Each face of the cube is keyed to a plane. Pressing a face once opens a gate to a random point on that plane, with a 10% chance per minute that an outsider comes through; pressing it again closes the gate, and only one gate can be open at once. Pressing a face twice quickly transports the activator and adjacent creatures to a random point on that plane, though adjacent creatures can avoid transport with Will DC 23.

items/gem-of-the-glitterdepth-614.name: Gem of the Glitterdepth [Relic]
items/gem-of-the-glitterdepth-614.effectSummary: A neutral-good, lawful-good, chaotic-good, or neutral wearer gains +2 enhancement to Wisdom. With the relic connection to Garl Glittergold, the gem also grants blindsense 30 feet and an instinctive sense of the walls, ceiling, and floor of any cavern regardless of its size or lighting.

items/hand-of-kiaransalees-glory.name: Hand of Kiaransalee's Glory
items/hand-of-kiaransalees-glory.effectSummary: A magic ring placed on one finger of the mummified hand functions normally for the wearer. Its five native silver rings each provide one spell effect once per day—deeper darkness, see invisibility, ray of enfeeblement, chill touch, or spectral hand—and replacing a silver ring with another magic ring sacrifices that ring's spell effect; removed silver rings have no magic.

items/jhuild.name: Jhuild (firewine)
items/jhuild.effectSummary: Each pint consumed grants +1 NPC morale level, -1 Wisdom, and +1 on all damage rolls for 2d4 hours, stacking to a maximum +5 morale and -5 Wisdom but never below Wisdom 1. A Constitution roll can avoid a pint's effects, with a cumulative -1 penalty per pint; when the duration ends, the drinker falls into a deep sleep for 3d4 hours.

items/keoghtoms-spidery-map.name: Keoghtom's Spidery Map
items/keoghtoms-spidery-map.effectSummary: Once per day, concentrating on a location, creature, or object causes the map to display the shortest direct physical route to it as a find the path effect. It cannot locate Keoghtom, his extradimensional home, deities, or anything beyond the current plane; all unrelated routes remain blurred.

items/orb-of-shadow.name: Orb of Shadow
items/orb-of-shadow.effectSummary: Once per day, holding and activating the orb as a standard action grants one extra use of a mystery of the orb's designated level, whether that mystery operates as a spell, spell-like ability, or supernatural ability. Orbs exist for mystery levels 1st through 9th, plus a version that recalls two mysteries per day of different levels no higher than 6th.

items/phasing-655.name: Phasing
items/phasing-655.effectSummary: As a standard action, the armor wearer can activate phasing to move through wood, plaster, or stone for a total of 60 feet per day, divided among passages as desired. Crossing a boundary between adjacent squares costs 5 feet, thicker barriers cost their thickness plus 5 feet, and exceeding the remaining allowance while inside material ejects the wearer back to the entry point prone.

items/ring-major-spell-storage-89.name: Ring of Major Spell Storage
items/ring-major-spell-storage-89.effectSummary: The ring stores up to ten total spell levels. The wearer can cast stored spells without components, focus, XP cost, or arcane spell failure; activation uses the spell's normal casting time with a minimum of 1 standard action. Spellcasters or scrolls can refill it up to the ten-level limit, metamagic spells consume their adjusted levels, and the ring reveals the names of stored spells to its wearer.

items/ring-minor-spell-storing-87.name: Ring of Minor Spell Storing
items/ring-minor-spell-storing-87.effectSummary: The ring stores up to three total spell levels. The wearer can cast stored spells without components, focus, XP cost, or arcane spell failure; activation uses the spell's normal casting time with a minimum of 1 standard action. Spellcasters or scrolls can refill it up to the three-level limit, metamagic spells consume their adjusted levels, and the ring reveals the names of stored spells to its wearer.

items/robe-of-transmutation.name: Robe of Transmutation
items/robe-of-transmutation.effectSummary: The robe increases by +1 the save DC of the wearer's shape-changing spells and makes the wearer immune to unwilling form-changing spells and supernatural effects. It grants polymorph and baleful polymorph once per day each, plus a once-daily prime transformation that lets the wearer assume one creature form from which they consumed a tiny piece, functioning like a single-form shapechange; the robe's powers remain available in the new form.
